title: docs(news): add the news pipeline repair skill
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added a local Claude Code skill, linked for Codex at `.agents/skills/news-pipeline`, for news pipeline repairs that need human judgment. It explains how to preview and rerun a date or post through `news-posts.yml` across morning, afternoon, daily, weekly, monthly, and models runs; reconcile a stuck send with `deliver.py mark` after checking the channel; interpret `delivery.json` states; and repair missing or incorrect PR gists. The guide warns that regenerating a gist posts to Discord again and covers tracing missing items in Enter’s Changelog or Updates and the README.
